description: do_deliver() checks envelope.require_tls && !peer.tls before TCP connect (relay_client.rs:299-305), not just after EHLO. This is defense-in-depth: the pre-connect guard ensures a REQUIRETLS message is never sent even if the EHLO check is bypassed by a future refactor. A contributor might suggest removing the pre-connect check as redundant — keep both. The pre-connect check is the meaningful guard; the post-EHLO check validates the peer's capability.
title: REQUIRETLS pre-connect guard before TCP prevents message leakage
